  "files": [
    {
      "path": "components/ui/refresh-control.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component",
      "target": "components/ui/refresh-control.tsx",
      "content": "import React from \"react\";\nimport { RefreshControlProps, RefreshControl as RNRefreshControl, ViewProps, } from \"react-native\";\nimport { THEME, useTheme } from \"@/lib/theme\";\nconst RefreshControl = React.forwardRef<RNRefreshControl, ViewProps & RefreshControlProps>(({ refreshing, onRefresh, colors, progressBackgroundColor, tintColor, titleColor, ...props }, ref) => {\n    const { theme } = useTheme();\n    const { colors: themeColors } = THEME[theme];\n    return (<RNRefreshControl ref={ref} refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh} tintColor={tintColor || themeColors.foreground} colors={colors || [themeColors.foreground]} progressBackgroundColor={progressBackgroundColor || themeColors.background} titleColor={titleColor || themeColors.foreground} {...props}/>);\n});\nRefreshControl.displayName = \"RefreshControl\";\nexport default RefreshControl;"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "$schema": "https://nativeui.qzz.io/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "lib-use-styles",
  "type": "registry:lib",
  "title": "Lib Use Styles",
  "description": "Lib Use Styles utility",
  "registryDependencies": [],
  "dependencies": [],
  "category": "layout",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "lib/use-styles.ts",
      "type": "registry:lib",
      "target": "lib/use-styles.ts",
      "content": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { ImageStyle, StyleSheet, TextStyle, ViewStyle } from \"react-native\";\nimport { THEME, Theme, useTheme } from \"@/lib/theme\";\nexport type NamedStyles = Record<string, ViewStyle | TextStyle | ImageStyle>;\nexport type ThemeObject = (typeof THEME)[Theme];\nfunction useStyles<T extends NamedStyles>(stylesheet: (theme: Theme, ThemeObj: ThemeObject) => T): T {\n    const { theme } = useTheme();\n    return useMemo(() => {\n        const themeObj = theme in THEME\n            ? THEME[theme as Theme]\n            : (theme as unknown as ThemeObject);\n        const themeName = theme in THEME ? (theme as Theme) : \"light\";\n        return StyleSheet.create(stylesheet(themeName, themeObj));\n    }, [theme]);\n}\nexport default useStyles;"
    }
  ]
}
